purpose: Mobile-only app release: iPhone and Android phones only; PC and tablet show a mobile-access notice; dedicated PC/tablet source remains preserved in archive branch; mobile-only QA must pass before protected Production promotion
last_retry_reason: The white-screen approach is now visual-only: PC/tablet app files and startup code remain untouched in the pinned source archive, while a full-screen white notice asks users to access the mobile site/app. Added explicit notice assertions and build checkpoints to identify the remaining pre-build guard failure. The private build still injects the mobile-only stylesheet into src/main.js, so its expected changed-file list remains index.html plus src/main.js.
